pages.text: 咘咘心里的小天气
pages.text_en: BUBU'S LITTLE WEATHER INSIDE

pages.text: 早上，阳光从窗帘缝里照进来，落在咘咘的裙子上。她一边刷牙一边想，今天要去公园玩，心里就出了大太阳，暖暖的，像被太阳抱了一下。
pages.text_en: In the morning, sunlight came through the curtains and fell on Bubu's dress. While brushing her teeth, she thought about going to the park today, and a big sun came out in her heart, warm, like being hugged by the sun.

pages.text: 咘咘在客厅里跳得高高的，手拍得啪啪响，笑声洒满了房间。妈妈笑着说：“高兴的时候，身体会跳起来，脸会笑，心会跳得快快的，连脚都想跳舞呢。”
pages.text_en: Bubu jumped high in the living room, clapping her hands with loud claps, laughter filling the room. Mummy smiled and said, "When you are happy, your body jumps up, your face smiles, your heart beats fast, and even your feet want to dance."

pages.text: 下午，咘咘搭了一座高高的积木塔，NOMI 在旁边递积木。她踮着脚，小心地放上最后一块，眼睛都不敢眨一下。
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu built a tall block tower, and NOMI passed her blocks beside her. She stood on tiptoe and carefully placed the last block, not daring to blink.

pages.text: 可是塔晃了一下，哗啦一声全倒了，积木滚得到处都是。咘咘愣住了，胸口紧紧的，脸热热的，眼睛也红红的，手也紧紧握着。
pages.text_en: But the tower wobbled and crashed down with a clatter, blocks rolling everywhere. Bubu froze, her chest tight, her face hot, her hands clenched tight.

pages.text: 妈妈说：“你看，生气的时候，身体会变紧，脸会变热，手会握成小拳头。身体先告诉你，生气来了，就像身体在拉警报一样。”
pages.text_en: Mummy said, "Look, when you are angry, your body goes tight, your face gets hot, and your hands make little fists. Your body tells you first that anger is here."

pages.text: 晚上，天上打了一个响雷，雨点啪啪地打在窗户上。咘咘一下子缩到妈妈身边，小手抖抖的，紧紧抓住妈妈的裙子。
pages.text_en: At night, thunder rumbled in the sky and raindrops pattered on the window. Bubu shrank beside Mummy at once, her little hands trembling, clutching Mummy's skirt tight.

pages.text: 妈妈轻轻抱住她说：“你看，害怕的时候，身体会缩起来，手会抖，还特别想找大人抱抱。缩起来不是胆小，是身体在请人帮忙。”
pages.text_en: Mummy held her gently and said, "Look, when you are scared, your body shrinks, your hands shake, and you really want a grown-up to hold you. Shrinking is not being cowardly; it is your body asking for help."

pages.text: 第二天，NOMI 拿来一张天气卡片，举到咘咘面前。卡片上有太阳、云朵、小雨和暴雨，都画得圆圆的，看着就想摸一摸。
pages.text_en: The next day, NOMI brought a weather card and held it up in front of Bubu. On the card were the sun, clouds, light rain and a storm, all drawn round and cute.

pages.text: NOMI 指着卡片说：“你看，情绪就像天气。有晴天，有阴天，也会有小雨和暴雨。每一种天气都会来，也都会走。”
pages.text_en: NOMI pointed at the card and said, "Look, feelings are like weather. There is sunshine, there are cloudy days, and there is light rain and storms too. Every kind of weather comes, and every kind goes away."

pages.text: 咘咘伸出小手指着卡片，认真地说：“早上我是晴天，下午我是暴雨，晚上我是小雨。一天里，我的心里可以有好几种天气呢！”
pages.text_en: Bubu pointed at the card with her little finger and said seriously, "In the morning I was sunny, in the afternoon I was a storm, and at night I was light rain. In one day, my heart can have many kinds of weather!"

pages.text: 她说着说着，自己都笑了，原来一天有这么多天气，一点也不奇怪。给天气起名字，心里就清楚多了，下次再有大暴雨，她也知道它叫什么了。
pages.text_en: As she talked, she laughed herself. So many kinds of weather in one day, and that was not strange at all. Giving the weather a name made her heart much clearer.

pages.text: 妈妈把她抱到沙发上，温柔地说：“情绪没有好坏。生气、高兴、害怕，都是真的，都是可以说的，没有一种是坏孩子才有的。”
pages.text_en: Mummy carried her to the sofa and said gently, "Feelings are not good or bad. Angry, happy, scared — they are all real, and they can all be said out loud."

pages.text: “你把心里的话说出来，爸爸妈妈才能听见你，才能陪你一起想办法，而不是让你一个人憋着。”咘咘点点头，把今天的事一件一件讲了出来。
pages.text_en: "When you say what is in your heart, Daddy and Mummy can hear you, and they can think of a way together with you, instead of leaving you to hold it all in alone." Bubu nodded and told today, one thing after another.

pages.text: NOMI 掰着手指教咘咘：“第一，暂停一下，按一下手掌。第二，闻花吹蜡烛，慢慢呼吸。”咘咘跟着做，肩膀松了一点。
pages.text_en: NOMI counted on his fingers and taught Bubu, "First, pause and press your palm. Second, smell a flower and blow out a candle, breathing slowly." Bubu followed him, and her shoulders relaxed a little.

pages.text: “第三，把话说出来，告诉别人你怎么了。第四，请大人帮忙，也不丢人。”咘咘跟着 NOMI 数，点点头记住了。
pages.text_en: "Third, say it out loud and tell others how you feel. Fourth, ask a grown-up for help — that is nothing to be ashamed of." Bubu counted along with NOMI and nodded, remembering.

pages.text: NONO 拍着翅膀飞过来，大声说：“哭也是可以的！”Coco 也笑着说：“Crying is okay！哭是可以的！”咘咘听了点点头，眼泪慢慢干了。她明白了，哭不是坏事，哭完了，心里反而会轻松一点。
pages.text_en: NONO flapped his wings and flew over, calling out, "Crying is okay too!" Coco smiled and said, "Crying is okay!" Bubu nodded, and her tears slowly dried. She understood that crying was not a bad thing; after crying, her heart felt lighter instead.

pages.text: 情绪过后，还可以修复：道歉、抱一下、一起收拾、再试一次。就像雨停了，太阳又出来了，心里也会慢慢晴起来。咘咘抱了抱妈妈，觉得心里真的亮了一点，像云被风吹开了一样。
pages.text_en: After a feeling, you can also repair: say sorry, hug, tidy up together, and try again. Just like after the rain stops, the sun comes out again, and the heart slowly brightens too. Bubu hugged Mummy and felt her heart really brighten a little, like clouds blown open by the wind.

pages.text: 睡前，咘咘裹着小毯子靠在妈妈身边，把今天的事一件一件讲给妈妈听：早上的晴天、下午的暴雨、晚上的小雨，还有她给每一种天气起的名字。妈妈亲了亲她的额头说：“你做得真好，今天的天气，你都认出来了。”
pages.text_en: At bedtime, wrapped in a little blanket and leaning against Mummy, Bubu told her about today, one thing after another: the morning sunshine, the afternoon storm, the night's light rain, and the names she had given each kind of weather. Mummy kissed her forehead and said, "You did so well. You recognised all of today's weather."

pages.text: 窗外，天气还在慢慢变化，云一会儿聚，一会儿散。咘咘知道，天气还会变，情绪还会来。没关系，下一次，她可以先说出它的名字，再用小工具慢慢等一等，等心里晴起来。
pages.text_en: Outside the window, the weather was still slowly changing, clouds gathering and scattering by turns. Bubu knew the weather would change again, and feelings would come again. It did not matter. Next time, she could first name it, then use her little tools and wait slowly until her heart turned sunny.
